matrix_scored_success_cases.interpretation: A fixed patch and two handoffs exist. An integration attempt was rejected for lacking the same candidate independent project+technical acceptance. Two recorded matrix-review calls are not sufficient evidence of same-version dual acceptance or submission; there was no submit_integration call before team5M boundary.

observations.finding: SPRINT coordination attempts occupy about31% of observed performed tool requests on its40closed cases; only one task successfully starts a sprint, one integrates a peer patch and one submits.
observations.interpretation: Many runs remain in planning/coordination rather than executing a complete sprint. This is an observed protocol usability problem, not an estimate of Scrum causal value.

observations.finding: CHIEF40closed cases contain only one successful org_assign_task and one successful integrate_patch;122of167 send_message calls were rejected as Unknown task.
observations.interpretation: A declared leader/team roster does not establish that task assignment and code integration actually occurred. Helpers can still consume tokens through separate browsing/reasoning.

observations.finding: PIPELINE44closed cases include41with successful design,20implementation handoff,8validation calls recorded and6legal delivery;12close with organization_contract_blocked.
observations.interpretation: Staged gating is visibly exercised, but many episodes fail to close the stage protocol. Successful governance API response is not official repair success.

observations.finding: REVIEW38closed cases include24handoffs,20peer integrations,17taskswith recorded reviews and13legal deliveries;51of69 send_message calls reject unknown tasks.
observations.interpretation: This group has more observed patch transfer/integration and delivery completion than CHIEF/SPRINT in these selected subsets; different tasks and cash censoring prevent a causal rank.

category_boundary: The original collaboration_operations metric includes task-board mutation/claim/dependency calls, org_status/org_* decisions, messages/transfers/handoffs/integrations. read_task remains separately available in tool_counts and is not included in that headline fraction. Private workbench and staff_done review requests are not counted as collaboration.
